sections.heading: Gutter Guards vs. Gutter Cleaning Services

runs.v: Gutter cleaning is essential to prevent clogs and damage: regular cleaning prevents mold and damage in gutters, heavy rainfall and freeze-thaw weather increase the need for regular gutter maintenance, and neglected gutters can lead to expensive water damage. West Orange has higher tree coverage than many places, and that heavy seasonal tree debris can often necessitate gutter guards, which help keep out leaves and debris during autumn and prevent clogs by keeping debris out. Many gutter cleaning services offer gutter cleaning plans twice a year or more; a guard lowers the risk of overflow between visits and helps protect the fascia and foundation, and that peace of mind is what most customers are buying.

Guard types include mesh, micro-mesh, and reverse-curve, and most install on existing gutters. Micro-mesh provides finer debris filtration than simpler screens, and micro-mesh makers advertise blocking 99% or more of debris. Quality guards typically have a lifespan of 20 to 25 years or more, which is why maintaining a sound gutter system under them matters: gutter systems generally last around 20 years with proper maintenance, while copper can last 50 years or more, decades longer than aluminum.
